```python
def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(case["required_symbols"])
    
    # Build node map and children map
    node_map = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
    children = {n["id"]: [] for n in nodes}
    for n in nodes:
        if n["parent"] is not None:
            children[n["parent"]].append(n["id"])
    
    # Track retained set
    retained = set(n["id"] for n in nodes)
    removed_order = []
    
    # Sort nodes: deepest first, then by node ID (lexicographic) as tie-break
    # "Consider deeper parse-tree nodes before shallower nodes"
    # "Use node ID as the stable tie break at equal depth"
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        nid = node["id"]
        
        # Never remove root (parent is null)
        if node["parent"] is None:
            continue
        
        # Never remove a required symbol
        if node["symbol"] in required_symbols:
            continue
        
        # Only removable nodes
        if not node["removable"]:
            continue
        
        # Never remove a node with retained children
        if any(child in retained for child in children[nid]):
            continue
        
        # Tentatively remove: check if all required symbols remain represented
        # Symbols in retained nodes after tentative removal
        tentative_retained = retained - {nid}
        symbols_present = set(node_map[rid]["symbol"] for rid in tentative_retained)
        
        if required_symbols.issubset(symbols_present):
            retained = tentative_retained
            removed_order.append(nid)
    
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removed_order,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_sorted
    }
```
